The **SUDDS-IV questionnaire (C4481659)**, a **T102-qualified group attribute**, serves as a critical component in assessing **substance use severity**, complementing the PDQ’s focus on familial context. The **Michigan Opioid Safety Score (MOSS) (C5684008)** and **ASAM Brief Level of Care Screening Tool** collectively represent **T102-qualified group attributes**, quantifying **opioid-related risks** and **care requirements**. Ultimately, the **Parental Drinking Questionnaire** emerges as a **T170-qualified intellectual product** that synthesizes **familial context**, **cognitive frameworks**, and **empirical data** into a cohesive assessment of **substance use**.
